Import kem file ShopdecorBee.postman_environment.json va chon environment truoc khi chay.

item.name: README - Thu tu chay Collection Runner

request.description:
Khong chay request nay. Dung huong dan ben duoi de chay Runner theo thu tu folder:

1. 00 - Setup (Seed All)
2. 01 - Auth (Login Customer + Login Admin)
3. 02 - Category (List Categories)
4. 03 - Product (List Products)
5. 04 - Cart (Prepare Cart For Order)
6. 05 - Order (Create Order for Payment + Prepare/Create Wallet Order)
7. 07 - Wallet (Deposit -> Pay Order)
8. 06 - Payment (COD -> Refund flow)

Hoac chay tung folder rieng cho tung task Jira.
